purpose: Private LS-only request-scoped actual-model KDA Q1/Q8 diagnostic; request bodies unchanged from the four-case target fixture.

messages.content:
CONTROL_ARITHMETIC_17_23
What is 17 multiplied by 23? Give the integer result.

CONTROL_COUNTING_1_1000
Write integers 1 through 1000, one per line.

CONTROL_LRU_CONCURRENCY
Analyze a concurrent LRU cache where two workers call get and evict while a third cancels an in-flight fill. Give a rigorous race analysis, invariants, linearization points, and minimal failure interleavings for naive designs. Use ten detailed sections.

CONTROL_DISTINCT_EARLY_PREFIX
Read this small inventory: shelf R4 has 12 copper bolts; shelf T9 has 7 zinc nuts; shelf W2 has 31 steel washers. Return only the shelf code containing zinc nuts.
